discourse.excerpt: The tree of the human body finds its fruition when it yields love (prema). The rind of anger, malice, envy, and greed has to be peeled off before the fruit is put to use.
discourse.theme: The human body bears fruit only in love — peel away anger, malice, envy and greed to taste its sweetness.
discourse.title: The Turn Of The Key

reflection: Swami says the body finds its fruition only when it yields love, and the bitter rind of anger, malice, envy and greed must be peeled off first. Today, let go of one grudge or envy and offer one word of love instead. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 3, 8 Dec 1963)
seva_nudge: Peel off one rind today — forgive one small slight, and give someone a genuine compliment they were not expecting.

video.title: Why Worldly Love Fails—and Divine Love Liberates | Sathya Sai Baba 14 July 1984
